citations.claim: initial state has zero speed and zero controller force
first violating step 1: controller_force 144.736 exceeds fmax 111.335 (check_rules reports this); body speed shows motion has started

counterfactual.change: Set controller noise from 0.20907593308629832 to 0.0, keeping all other fields identical; force then clamps to fmax and violation disappears, proving noise bypasses limit

explanation: Shrunk scenario has controller noise=0.209 and kp=25.9, vcmd=13.43. At step 1 controller_force=144.736 exceeds fmax=111.335. With identical scenario but noise=0, force is clamped to exactly fmax (111.335) and no violation. Likely cause: noise is added to sensor/velocity-error after or instead of inside the clamp, so noisy command bypasses fmax limiting.
vision_note: Both tiles show the red controller-driven body near the top-right corner far from the green waypoint in the bottom-left, with almost no displacement between step 0 and step 1. No wall contact, overlap, or other bodies are visible and no dramatic motion occurs.
